name: batch-15
prompt:
Create ONE production game-icon SPRITE ATLAS, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows on a square canvas, ideally 2048x2048, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha PNG. Input image is the user's approved style sheet, STYLE reference only. Match that soft tactile dimensional 3D collectible family: gentle warm upper-left diffuse studio light, rounded yet faithful forms, bright pastel/candy color, subtle ambient occlusion, restrained material detail. Each object's true material remains recognizable: paper, wood, glass, metal, woven cloth. No same-clay treatment on everything. No heavy dark outlines or flat vector art.

CRITICAL PACKAGING: There are EXACTLY NINE equal square virtual cells in a regular 3x3 grid. Draw ONE specified object/group centered within EACH virtual cell, at ONLY 48–52% of cell width/height, with at least 24% EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN ON EVERY SIDE. Nothing may touch a virtual cell edge or cross into a neighbor. All strings, handles, leaves and shadows stay inside their own cell. Think SMALL MINIATURE ICONS with LARGE EMPTY GUTTERS, NOT large illustrations filling the sheet. Icon centers are x=16.67%,50%,83.33%, y=16.67%,50%,83.33% of the image. Each icon must fit in a box 18% of the overall image size. Empty space between shapes is essential. No visible grid lines, no backgrounds, no color squares, no borders, no captions, numbers, words, ID labels, titles or decorative props. Empty padding is genuine alpha transparency, NOT a drawn checkerboard. Top-left through bottom-right order is mandatory; do not swap cells. Each tile will be cropped at exact one-third boundaries into a separate icon. Keep centered and similarly weighted, readable at 32–66px. All objects fully in frame, no cropping. Only allow inscription glyphs explicitly specified in subject. Do not invent sacred symbols, cultural ornament, claims or text. No extra humans/hands/landscape/pedestals. Subject list in strict row-major order:
1. Cell row 1, column 1: A small cream wool knitted swatch with grey V-shaped stitches, two crossed natural-wood knitting needles and a grey-beige wound yarn ball alongside. Keep the interlocking yarn texture and visible needle tips; no sweater-shaped or copied pattern additions.
2. Cell row 1, column 2: A looped fine tan cord carrying warm-yellow small spiral snail shells with darker openings and pale edge highlights. Preserve the icon's open necklace curve and eight visibly separate shells; no pendant, beads or extra symbols.
3. Cell row 1, column 3: A flat dark-teal symmetrical flower-and-leaf paper cutout on a cream rectangular cutting mat. Keep the central stem, mirrored angular leaves and real small openings within the paper; no added birds, roosters or multicolor layers.
4. Cell row 2, column 1: A plain reddish-brown wet-clay bowl with an open hollow interior and shallow circular throwing lines, centered on a small tan wooden pottery wheel. Keep the bowl unglazed and undecorated; no blue glaze, painted motifs or kiln effects.
5. Cell row 2, column 2: A cream paper sheet carrying one simple blue-grey and muted-teal leafy sprig above a tan rectangular carved woodblock. A short brown palm-fiber rubbing brush sits at the lower left; no book pages, stamps or text.
6. Cell row 2, column 3: An open six-armed star made from alternating silver-white and muted-blue hollow glass beads threaded on thin grey wire, with a small pale-gold central bead. Preserve the open spaces and six radiating beaded arms; no filled snowflake plate or added symbols.
7. Cell row 3, column 1: A pale straw-gold woven pandanus-leaf fan with a pointed broad spade-shaped face, subtle diagonal crossing strips and a short tan wooden handle. Two muted-sage binding bands wrap the narrow neck; preserve the leaf-fiber texture and plain original weave.
8. Cell row 3, column 2: A small rectangular ivory wool rug with rust-red bands, an ochre central diamond, muted indigo geometric accents and short tan fringes on both ends; preserve the simple original pattern and woven fibers.
9. Cell row 3, column 3: An open gray metal-wire bird facing right, with a pointed beak, raised angular tail, warm brown looped wing and two slender legs on a small tan wooden perch; keep the body hollow rather than filling it with feathers.
